scripts.deploy: npm run db:remote && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:local: npm run build && npm run deploy
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:production && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.production.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json

DB.description: Private mailbox metadata. A new D1 database is provisioned for this installation.

MAIL_STORE.description: Private R2 storage for email bodies, original messages, and attachments. Enable R2 on your account first.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: Your Cloudflare Access sign-in email. Only this identity manages shared infrastructure and receives ownership of existing mailboxes.

ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare account ID, used to restrict domain discovery to your account.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Zero Trust team URL, such as https://your-team.cloudflareaccess.com.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Application audience (AUD) from your Cloudflare Access application. Mail HQ remains locked until Access is configured.

APP_ORIGIN.description: Your dashboard HTTPS origin, such as https://mail.example.com. Add the matching Worker custom domain and Access application.

MCP_HOST.description: Separate Worker hostname for MCP and public OAuth endpoints, such as mcp.mail.example.com. User approval uses the Access-protected dashboard.

OAUTH_KV.description: Private OAuth client registrations, grants, and token records. D1 holds mailbox permissions and revocation state.

EMAIL_WORKER_NAME.description: Must match the Worker name selected above. Used when creating new email routing rules.

REDIRECT_HOSTS.description: Optional comma-separated old dashboard hostnames. Leave blank for a new installation.

CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generate 32 random bytes as base64 with `openssl rand -base64 32`. Never share or rotate without re-encrypting stored configuration.
